requirements.statement: /rebase-project (and only it, never the scaffold's --refresh, a plain scaffold or --git-files) untracks, after the ignore lines are delivered, every tracked run-record file under .trd-state/ that the project's .gitignore now ignores: index only, staged, never committed, files kept on disk; .trd-state/_docs-audit/ stays tracked. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1 (source: roadmap item 5 brief; report Migration step 4)

requirements.statement: /rebase-project seeds refs/ensemble/records/<slug> from each in-flight feature's current state folder, so the ref's implement.json equals the folder's. In flight: the folder has implement.json and no closed.json, or its current ship run (as ship-record-dir.js resolveRun decides) has not finished; AND the folder is in a worktree of this repository whose checked-out branch is the branch the folder's records name. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O2 (source: roadmap item 5 brief; adversarial review: 21 legacy folders in this repo have implement.json, no closed.json, and merged or deleted branches)

requirements.statement: A finished feature gets no ref, and neither does a folder whose recorded branch is not the branch checked out in its worktree; finished records stay readable in main's history. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O3 (source: roadmap item 5 brief; Forge N7)

requirements.statement: Nothing is committed by the cutover, neither the untracking nor the seeding. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O4 (source: roadmap item 5 brief, 'staged and never committed'; acceptance 'nothing was committed')

requirements.statement: The seeded ref has the tree layout and record.json fields (forge_feature_id, branch, slug) of Forge's reader contract, including the evidence images the folder's verification report references; branch is the feature's own branch, and forge_feature_id is the folder's own (never the rebase session's FORGE_FEATURE_ID). Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O5 (forge-vnext docs/TRD/run-records-ref-reader.md D5/O13, as matched by record-ref.js)

requirements.statement: A ref that already exists (locally or on origin), or whose existence on origin cannot be checked, is never seeded or overwritten. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O6 (adversarial review: a stale worktree copy would replace the feature's newer records)

requirements.statement: /rebase-project's readout reports which files were untracked, which refs were seeded, and which in-flight features were skipped, with why. Must pass: no (not marked).

A BATS test in packages/core/scripts/scaffold-project.test.sh with a fixture repo holding one in-flight and one finished feature proves O1 to O4; a prose test on rebase-project.md pins the new step; mirrors, docs/reference/ and CHANGELOG.md are updated; the battery stays green. Must pass: no (not marked).
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O8 (roadmap item 5, 'How it will be checked')
